svg.text: Calculation time per cycle on the Jetson Orin Nano
Share of cycles per 0.25 ms bin. Pair period 11.1 ms; limit 5 ms (99 % of track cycles), goal 2 ms.
Sources: tracker/logs/jetson/replay_synth_track/live.csv; tracker/logs/link_{1,2,3}/viewer_poses.csv (3 x 60 s live). Cycles above 20 ms are counted in the last bin.
Track state, live, locked on static scenery (not the object)
